title: The modern world, 1800–2026
reviewed: 2026-10-18. Each quote was copied from the linked article and is checked by npm run verify:sources.

events.title: Britain bans the Atlantic slave trade
events.summary: Parliament prohibits the Atlantic slave trade across the British Empire.

source.quote: royal assent by King George III on 25 March 1807

events.title: The Battle of Waterloo
events.summary: A coalition army defeats Napoleon in Belgium. His rule of France ends.

source.quote: fought on Sunday 18 June 1815

events.title: Darwin publishes On the Origin of Species
events.summary: Charles Darwin sets out the theory of evolution by natural selection.

source.quote: It was published on 24 November 1859.

events.image: File:A v Werner - Kaiserproklamation am 18 Januar 1871 (3. Fassung 1885).jpg
events.title: The German Empire is proclaimed
events.summary: The German states unite under Prussia. The new empire is proclaimed at Versailles.

source.quote: led by the Kingdom of Prussia of Hohenzollerns on 18 January 1871

events.title: World War I
events.summary: An assassination in Sarajevo sets off a global war between two great alliances. Millions die.

source.quote: (28 July 1914 – 11 November 1918)

events.title: The Russian Revolution
events.summary: Revolution ends the Russian monarchy. The Bolsheviks seize power later that year.

source.quote: political and social change in Russia starting in 1917

events.title: World War II
events.summary: Germany's invasion of Poland begins a world war between the Allies and the Axis. It is the deadliest war in history.

source.quote: (1 September 1939 – 2 September 1945)

events.title: The World Wide Web is invented
events.summary: Tim Berners-Lee invents the Web at CERN. It opens to the public in 1993.

source.quote: while at CERN in 1989 and opened to the public in 1993

events.title: The Berlin Wall falls
events.summary: East Germany opens the border in Berlin. The division of Europe begins to end.

source.quote: The Berlin Wall fell on 9 November 1989

events.title: The Soviet Union dissolves
events.summary: The Soviet Union ceases to exist. Fifteen republics become independent states.

source.quote: On 26 December 1991, the Soviet Union was formally dissolved

events.title: The Ottoman Empire ends
events.summary: Turkey's Grand National Assembly abolishes the sultanate. The Republic of Turkey follows.

source.quote: abolished the monarchy on 1 November 1922 and ended the Ottoman Empire

events.title: The State of Israel is proclaimed
events.summary: David Ben-Gurion proclaims the State of Israel. War with neighboring Arab states follows.

source.quote: proclaimed at the Tel Aviv Museum on 14 May 1948

events.title: The Iranian Revolution
events.summary: A revolution overthrows the Pahlavi monarchy. Iran becomes an Islamic republic.

source.quote: culminated in the overthrow of the Pahlavi dynasty in 1979

events.title: The Sokoto Caliphate is founded
events.summary: Usman dan Fodio founds a caliphate in what is now northern Nigeria. It becomes West Africa's most populous state.

source.quote: founded by Usman dan Fodio in 1804

events.title: Liberia declares independence
events.summary: Settlers in a colony founded for freed Black Americans declare Liberia independent.

source.quote: adopted by the Liberian Constitutional Convention on 26 July 1847

events.title: The Suez Canal opens
events.summary: A canal links the Mediterranean and the Red Sea. Ships no longer need to sail around Africa.

source.quote: it officially opened on 17 November 1869

events.title: Ethiopia defeats Italy at Adwa
events.summary: Emperor Menelik II's army defeats an Italian invasion. Ethiopia keeps its independence.

source.quote: It was fought on 1 March 1896

events.image: File:Patrice Lumumba signs the document granting independence to the Congo next to Belgian Prime Minister Gaston Eyskens.jpg
events.title: The Year of Africa
events.summary: Seventeen African nations win independence in a single year. Nigeria is the most populous of them.

source.quote: mainly the independence of seventeen African nations

events.title: South Africa's first all-race election
events.summary: Citizens of all races vote for the first time. Apartheid ends, and Nelson Mandela becomes president.

source.quote: held in South Africa between 26 and 29 April 1994

events.title: The genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda
events.summary: Extremists carry out a genocide against the Tutsi during Rwanda's civil war.

source.quote: occurred from 7 April to 19 July 1994

events.image: File:Felice Beato (British, born Italy - (Exterior of The Secundra Bagh) - Google Art Project.jpg
events.title: The Indian Rebellion of 1857
events.summary: Soldiers and civilians rise against the East India Company. Britain then takes direct rule of India.

source.quote: The rebellion began on 10 May 1857

events.image: File:A refugee special train at Ambala Station during partition of India.jpg
events.title: Independence and the partition of India
events.summary: British rule ends and India and Pakistan become independent. Partition uproots millions of people.

source.quote: The partition of India in 1947

events.title: Bangladesh wins independence
events.summary: After a war of liberation, East Pakistan becomes the independent nation of Bangladesh.

source.quote: Pakistan surrendered in Dhaka on 16 December 1971

events.title: The First Opium War
events.summary: Britain goes to war with Qing China over the opium trade. China cedes Hong Kong.

source.quote: between the British Empire and Qing China between 1839 and 1842

events.title: The Meiji Restoration
events.summary: Power returns to Japan's emperor. Japan modernizes rapidly.

source.quote: On 3 January 1868, Emperor Meiji declared political power to be restored

events.title: The Xinhai Revolution ends imperial China
events.summary: An uprising at Wuchang brings down the Qing dynasty. China becomes a republic.

source.quote: The flashpoint came on 10 October 1911 with the Wuchang Uprising

events.title: The atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki
events.summary: The United States drops two atomic bombs on Japanese cities. Japan surrenders weeks later.

source.wiki: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki
source.quote: On 6 and 9 August 1945, the United States detonated two atomic bombs

events.title: The People's Republic of China is proclaimed
events.summary: Mao Zedong proclaims the People's Republic in Tiananmen Square.

source.wiki: Proclamation of the People's Republic of China
source.quote: on October 1, 1949, in Tiananmen Square in Beijing

events.title: The Korean War
events.summary: North and South Korea fight a war that draws in the United Nations and China. It ends in an armistice.

events.title: The COVID-19 pandemic
events.summary: A new coronavirus spreads from Wuhan across the world in early 2020. The WHO ends the global emergency in May 2023.

quote: began with an outbreak in Wuhan, China, in December 2019

events.title: Indonesia proclaims independence
events.summary: Sukarno reads the proclamation of independence. A war against Dutch rule follows.

source.quote: on Friday, 17 August 1945 in Jakarta

events.image: File:The air evacuation of siege-stricken Vietnamese from Saigon to the U.S. was conducted after the Babylift operation.... - NARA - 542335.tif
events.title: The fall of Saigon
events.summary: North Vietnam captures Saigon. The Vietnam War ends.

source.quote: captured by North Vietnam on 30 April 1975

events.title: The Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami
events.summary: A huge earthquake off Sumatra sends tsunamis across the Indian Ocean.

source.quote: On 26 December 2004

events.title: Russia takes Tashkent
events.summary: Russian forces attack Tashkent during their conquest of Central Asia.

source.quote: In April 1865, Chernayev made a second attack on Tashkent.

events.title: Sputnik 1 orbits the Earth
events.summary: The Soviet Union launches the first artificial satellite. The space age begins.

source.quote: by the Soviet Union on 4 October 1957

events.image: File:Louisiana Purchase New Orleans Thure de Thulstrup.jpg
events.title: The Louisiana Purchase
events.summary: The United States buys the vast Louisiana territory from France.

source.quote: from the French First Republic in 1803

events.title: Mexico's War of Independence
events.summary: A long struggle ends Spanish rule in Mexico.

source.quote: 16 September 1810 – 27 September 1821

events.title: The Battle of Ayacucho
events.summary: Patriot forces defeat the last large Spanish army in South America.

source.quote: On 9 December 1824, the Battle of Ayacucho

events.title: The American Civil War
events.summary: The Union and the Confederacy fight over slavery and secession. The Union wins, and slavery ends.

events.title: The first transcontinental railroad
events.summary: A golden spike joins the rails across the United States at Promontory Summit.

source.quote: between Sacramento and Omaha on May 10, 1869

events.title: Brazil abolishes slavery
events.summary: Princess Isabel signs the Golden Law, ending slavery in Brazil.

source.quote: 13 May 1888, is the law that abolished slavery in Brazil

events.image: File:Opening of the Panama Canal SS Ancon approaching Gamboa Looking north Aug 15, 1914 - DPLA - 0c0baedc6b427a89406d5779c16b4205.jpg
events.title: The Panama Canal opens
events.summary: A canal across Panama links the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.

source.quote: Since its inauguration on 15 August 1914

events.title: The Wall Street crash
events.summary: Stock prices collapse in New York. The worldwide Great Depression follows.

source.quote: began in October 1929

events.title: The United Nations Charter is signed
events.summary: Delegates from around the world sign the charter that founds the United Nations.

source.quote: opened for signature on 26 June 1945

events.title: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon
events.summary: American astronauts become the first people to walk on the Moon.

source.quote: Apollo 11 (July 16–24, 1969)

events.title: The September 11 attacks
events.summary: Al-Qaeda hijackers crash airliners in New York and near Washington. Nearly 3,000 people die.

source.quote: Early on the morning of September 11, 2001

events.title: The Treaty of Waitangi
events.summary: The British Crown and Māori chiefs sign a treaty. New Zealand becomes a British colony.

source.quote: It was first signed on 6 February 1840

events.title: New Zealand women win the vote
events.summary: A new law gives New Zealand women the vote. They vote in a general election that November.

source.quote: given royal assent by Governor Lord Glasgow on 19 September 1893

events.title: Australia federates
events.summary: Six British colonies unite as the Commonwealth of Australia.

source.quote: came into force, on 1 January 1901
